meta.title: Systemic Fitness — We train your body system
meta.description: Systemic Fitness is a condition-based training program designed to train your whole body system to work more stable and optimal from within.

hero.headline1: Your body is more than muscle.
hero.sub: Your body is more than just muscle. It's an integrated system. Systemic Fitness is not a typical gym or fitness program. It's a specialized training program designed to train your entire body system, ensuring every system functions with greater stability and optimal efficiency from within.

signals.headline1: Systemic Fitness is designed for those who seek precision in training
signals.headline2: and wish to remain active while managing specific health conditions.
signals.sub: Systemic Fitness is a specialized program designed to manage systemic health challenges by focusing on restoring stability and improving overall health from within.

cards.c1Desc: Early-stage issues with blood pressure, cholesterol, blood sugar, immunity, kidneys, inflammation, or metabolic health.
cards.c2Desc: Addressing PCOS, thyroid disorders, perimenopause, and other complex feminine health challenges.
cards.c3Desc: Designed to enhance physical strength and stamina, ensuring peak performance, masculinity, and high-level productivity at work.
cards.c4Desc: For those who are already exercising but have yet to see significant improvements in their overall health markers.

method.headline1: Systemic Fitness is built on three essential pillars.
method.headline2: These are delivered in a strategic sequence to achieve comprehensive optimization of the body's internal systems.
method.quote: "We don't train bodies. We train systems."
method.quoteAuthor: — Citra Hann, Founder & Human System Expert
method.variablesIntro: Each pillar in the Systemic Fitness is controlled through 4 core variables

variables.v1Desc: The precise application of resistance to trigger a targeted physiological response.
variables.v2Desc: Foundational mechanics that define and optimize the body's functional efficiency.
variables.v3Desc: The speed and rhythm of exercise based on BPM (Beats Per Minute) to regulate system responses and activate thermogenesis.
variables.v4Desc: Specific breathing techniques that control stability and enhance the efficiency of the body's internal systems.

pillarDetails.fcSubtitle: Focus: Blood circulation, fascial mobility, and fundamental movement.
pillarDetails.ccSubtitle: Focus: Activating the cardiovascular, circulatory, and respiratory systems.
pillarDetails.mcSubtitle: Focus: Increasing muscle mass, boosting metabolism, and promoting cellular regeneration through measured resistance training.

classification.tag: PROGRAM CLASSIFICATION BY BODY SYSTEM CONDITION
classification.headline1: Each Systemic Fitness program is designed
classification.headline2: around the body system that needs to be improved or optimized.
classification.sub: This approach makes training more effective for your specific health condition.

cards.immuneDesc: For conditions tied to the immune system and inflammation. Helps the body lower inflammation, build resilience, and sharpen immune response.
cards.renalDesc: For conditions tied to kidney function and uric acid balance. Training supports fluid metabolism and eases the load on the excretory system.
cards.cardioDesc: For conditions tied to the heart, blood vessels, and respiration. Improves circulation, cardiac efficiency, and breathing quality safely and under control.
cards.metabolicDesc: For conditions tied to metabolism, such as blood sugar, body weight, and energy. Helps the body manage energy more efficiently and steadily.
cards.musculoDesc: For conditions tied to muscles, joints, and structure. Builds strength and mobility, and reduces pain and tension.

programs.sub: Through the assessment, we identify the condition of your body system, then determine the program that fits you best.

cards.p1Desc: For those with more than two active medical conditions. The program is specifically designed by a Systemic Consultant to fit your health condition.
cards.p1F1: Program is personally designed by a Systemic Consultant
cards.p1F2: Training Card based on your body system condition
cards.p1F3: Chronobiology window aligned with your health condition
cards.p1F4: Nutrition guidance tailored to your health condition
cards.p2Desc: For those with one or two active medical conditions. The program focuses on optimizing body system function and is adapted to your health condition.
cards.p2F1: Program designed in advance by a Systemic Consultant
cards.p2F2: Training Card based on your Systemic Assessment results
cards.p2F3: Chronobiology window aligned with your health condition
cards.p2F4: Nutrition guidance tailored to your health condition
cards.p3Desc: For those without active medical conditions, who want to maintain and elevate overall health. Focuses on balance, performance, and long-term system resilience.
cards.p3F1: Program is designed based on your age and gender
cards.p3F2: Training Card is structured to optimize your body system function
cards.p3F3: Chronobiology window aligned with your condition
cards.p3F4: Nutrition guidance to support performance and long-term health

score.headline2: Not just a number, but a reflection of how your body system is working.
score.sub: Built from three core dimensions that determine the quality of your health and performance.
score.formulaBottom: Measured through the systemic assessment and updated after every completed session.

steps.s1Desc: A short questionnaire covering your movement, health, sleep, and nutrition. Complimentary.
steps.s2Desc: Discover your level, the ideal program, and the optimal training window tailored to your unique chronobiology.
steps.s3Desc: A Training Card with personalized variables, specifically designed for your health condition.
steps.s4Desc: Track your progress through an updating Systemic Score. As your body improves, your program evolves to keep you advancing.

testimonials.sub: Real Body System Transformations from Systemic Fitness Clients.

items.t1Desc: After 3 months on the Condition-Specific Program, my blood pressure and cholesterol dropped significantly. The difference is clear: every session is built for my specific condition, not generic.
items.t2Title: My hormones finally found their balance.
items.t2Desc: I tried so many approaches for perimenopause over 5 years. Systemic Fitness was the first to understand that hormones need a specific movement window and intensity.
items.t3Title: A method that finally feels precise.
items.t3Desc: As a physician I'm critical of fitness claims. This 4-variable approach is consistent with the exercise physiology literature — and I've felt the result myself.
items.t4Title: Scoliosis is no longer a barrier.
items.t4Desc: Scoliosis is no longer a barrier to my active lifestyle. Thanks to this comprehensive method, I move with much more freedom. The transformation goes beyond posture — I've noticed a significant increase in my cardiovascular capacity.
items.t5Title: Toned, firm, feminine — a huge confidence booster.
items.t5Desc: Years of struggling with PCOS left me feeling exhausted. But after just 10 sessions of Systemic Fitness, I've experienced a major shift. My body feels much more toned, firm, and feminine. It's a huge confidence booster!

partner.sub: At Systemic Fitness, we integrate health protocols into your daily life. Through a system that is monitored and measured, we ensure your health transformation is not just achieved, but sustained.

items.i1Desc: Partner with us as our Clinical Advisor. Together, we can monitor patient progress beyond the clinic and ensure outcomes meet your highest standards.
items.i2Desc: A thriving business begins with a healthy workforce. We provide tailored health solutions to keep your team in peak form, resulting in sustained high performance across the company.
items.i3Desc: Join as a Program Executor using expert-designed Training Cards. Execute each session with precision and consistency, maintaining the high standards of the Systemic Fitness method.

partner.quoteText: "Theory is easy to find, but execution is where most people struggle. I've spent years working with complex health conditions, and that experience led me to create Systemic Fitness. My goal is simple: to provide a program that actually works in the real world, ensuring your results are both effective and sustainable."

pricing.headline2: tailored to your condition and needs.
pricing.sub: Every program includes a Systemic Assessment, Score, and Nutrition Guide. To truly transform your health and see the best results, this program is designed as a 3-month journey.

paymentGuide.title: Payment Guide
paymentGuide.sub: Step-by-step transaction flow from booking to checkout using Midtrans in the Systemic Fitness mobile app.
paymentGuide.step1Desc: Select the Systemic Membership program that suits your health condition.
paymentGuide.step2Desc: Complete the initial assessment to determine your health level and personalize your program.
paymentGuide.step3Desc: Review your order and select your preferred payment method via Midtrans (Virtual Account, Credit Card, e-Wallet, etc).
paymentGuide.step4Desc: Once payment is verified, your personalized training program will be unlocked immediately.
